notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4, Total Governmental Funds 2022 column). Taxes 56,908 split with the General Fund (p11: 56,424) and Street Fund (p14: township taxes 455 + property tax credit 29 = 484) schedule rows (ties exactly; Statement of Activities property taxes - general purpose 43,790 = 40,717 + 2,589 + 455 + 29, other taxes 13,118 = 6,623 + 6,495). Intergovernmental - state 103,341 split with the General (35,877) and Street (67,464) schedule rows. Other 70,743 split with the fund schedules (General 20,689, Public Trust 250, Community Improvement 225, Cafe 43,046, Housing 1,773, Cemetery 3,260 + Medical Center 1,500). Interest 6,299 kept as one statement line. NPPD 6,495 is In Lieu of Tax (budget schedule p10 prints it as In-lieu-of tax). Fund balances in *_fund_balance; cash = Cash + cash held by county treasurer from p3 (2022 / 2021 columns), CDs and investments in *_investments; restricted cash and CDs (32,675 / 38,973) left out of both. Business-type lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (pp6-7, 2022 Totals column), measure cash (447,038 to 403,128 incl. restricted cash, p9); no single total printed, totals computed (operating + nonoperating). Federal grant repayment 88,238 (nonoperating) recorded as a disbursement (category other, review). Capital contributions - Federal grant proceeds 37,957 (p7, printed below income before capital contributions) in business_type.other_financing. Proprietary cash flow statement (pp8-9) not recorded in proprietary, as in later years. Detail: per-fund schedules for every governmental fund (pp11-21); the combined all-funds budget schedule (p10) is not used (combined, superseded by fund schedules); no business-type statement lines (funds with schedules are governmental; user 2026-10-28 rule). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p3, totals equal government-wide 804,423), business-type from the proprietary funds statement (p5); totals from p1.
